Extend selection_workflow_state values to include 'scheduled'. Idempotent migration in server/src/config/migrations/biddingMigration.ts.

tasks.title: Move bid to 'scheduled' on deposit conversion (server)
tasks.description: Update server/src/services/depositService.ts convertDepositToFee to set selection_workflow_state='scheduled' (replacing 'addresses_revealed' as the new entry state for the post-payment phase). Address reveal still happens via redactors.ts ADDRESS_REVEALED_STATES — extend that list to include 'scheduled'. Insert workorder_visits row with status='pending_first_check'.

tasks.title: visitTrackingService: confirm/reminder/abandon state machine
tasks.description: Create server/src/services/visitTrackingService.ts with: getStatus(bidId, ownerId) returns current row + can_confirm flag (true once now >= proposed_start_date); confirmVisit(bidId, ownerId, visited:boolean) — if true, advance bid to 'in_progress'; if false and status='pending_first_check', flip to 'reminder_sent'; sendReminder(bidId, ownerId) — queues email_outbox row for contractor + flips status to 'pending_second_check' + bumps reminder_count; abandonAsNoShow(bidId, ownerId) — only when status='pending_second_check', sets status='owner_marked_abandoned', calls existing FT-855 credit-transfer flow + increments contractor_profiles.abandonment_flag_count.

tasks.title: API endpoints for visit confirmation + reminder + abandon
tasks.description: Add controllers + routes: GET /api/bids/:id/visit-status, POST /api/bids/:id/visit-confirmation {visited:bool}, POST /api/bids/:id/visit-reminder, POST /api/bids/:id/abandon-no-show. Owner-only authorization via isBidVisibleTo. Wire into server/src/controllers/bidController.ts and server/src/routes/bidRoutes.ts. Create tests/api_definitions/bids-visit-*.json.

tasks.title: VisitTrackingPanel on HomeownerDashboard
tasks.description: Create client/src/components/common/VisitTrackingPanel.tsx that shows on owner side when bidWorkflowState='scheduled' and now>=proposed_start_date. UI: 'Has the contractor visited and discussed the work?' Yes/No buttons → if No on first check, second card 'Send a reminder to the contractor' button + tip to call them; after reminder, third card 'Did the contractor visit after the reminder?' Yes/No → if No, danger button 'Mark workorder as abandoned (deposit credits to next bidder, no refund)' with confirmation dialog. Add to HomeownerDashboard accepted-bid section.

tasks.title: Add no-refund + credit-to-next-winner clauses to work order document
tasks.description: Update server/src/services/contractGenerator.ts (both generateContract draft and generateSignedContract) Terms section: add explicit clause stating that the 5% BidWork platform deposit is non-refundable in cash, and that if the contractor abandons the workorder (no-show after homeowner reminder OR explicit abandon), the deposit converts to a credit applied automatically to the next-ranked shortlisted bidder for the same project; the homeowner does not get a cash refund.

tasks.title: Show contractor abandonment count + rating in bid cards
tasks.description: Update server/src/services/bidService.ts getBidsForProject and listing endpoints to attach contractor reputation: abandonment_flag_count (already on contractor_profiles), aggregate rating avg + count, total_completed_orders (count of bids in receipt_issued state). Update client BidCard/HomeownerBidsList to render a small reputation badge: ★ 4.6 (12 ratings) · 18 jobs · 1 abandoned.

tasks.title: ratingService + endpoints for rating request/submit/reputation
tasks.description: Create server/src/services/ratingService.ts: requestRating(bidId, contractorId) — only when bid in 'receipt_issued', inserts contractor_ratings row status='requested' + emails owner; submitRating(bidId, ownerId, rating, review_text) — validates 1..5, sets status='submitted'; getContractorReputation(contractorId) returns {avg, count, completed, abandoned}. Add routes: POST /api/bids/:id/request-rating (contractor), POST /api/bids/:id/rating (owner), GET /api/contractors/:id/reputation. Create tests/api_definitions/ratings-*.json.

tasks.title: RatingPanel UI for both dashboards
tasks.description: Create client/src/components/common/RatingPanel.tsx. Contractor side: when bidWorkflowState='receipt_issued' and no rating row exists, show 'Request a rating from the homeowner' button → POST /request-rating. Once requested, show 'Rating requested · awaiting homeowner'. Once submitted, show stars + review. Homeowner side: when ratings.status='requested', show 5-star picker + optional textarea + Submit. Mount in HomeownerDashboard + ContractorDashboard accepted-bid section.
